definition: Ofer Dekel (Hebrew: עופר דקל) is a computer science researcher in the Machine Learning Department of Microsoft Research.
details: He obtained his PhD in computer science from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem and is an affiliate faculty at the Computer Science & Engineering department at the University of Washington.

explainer.lead: Ofer Dekel (researcher) is a computer science researcher in the Machine Learning Department of Microsoft Research. His work spans machine learning.
